E_aggregated.action_count_comment: No official Kakao tool-name list was found: the official Kakao Entertainment blog page was checked, but its captured/rendered content exposes only the article title and author. Claude's connector directory lists 26 exact names and says Kakao Entertainment made the connector; Claude is third-party evidence and the directory marks it Anthropic verified. ToolJunction independently lists 26 names matching that set, including report_streaming_card and report_streaming_total. No names were added from catalogues beyond those 26. APIs.io and MCP.so each describe 18 tools under different names, apparently reflecting a separate or revised naming inventory; their full count differs from the 26-name listing. ToolJunction marks three search tools READ and the others EXEC; action types here are inferred from apparent function because no official annotations/schema were available.

F_documentation.implementation_hints_not_enforced: Third-party APIs.io descriptions include agent instructions such as “Always call `get_genres` first…” and “If no valid results are returned, retry the search by translating the keywords into English or correcting any typos.” No public server code or official schema was available to determine whether these recommendations are enforced.
F_documentation.governance_promises: The official privacy disclosure lists authentication information and Melon service usage history for MCP service provision and related operations, and gives retention as until the connection is unlinked, with prompt destruction upon unlinking. The general privacy policy describes lawful and secure processing, but does not establish MCP-specific technical controls.
F_documentation.promises_to_user: The Claude connector listing describes browsing charts and artist, album, and track details, music search, personalized recommendations, and playback in the Melon app. It states the service was currently available in Korean only and anticipated an English version in October 2026.
F_documentation.comparison_with_server_logic: The unlinking retention statement is present in the vendor's privacy disclosure, but technical deletion enforcement was not inspectable. Product feature descriptions are catalogue claims; there is no public implementation to compare. Tool guidance is catalogue text, with enforcement Unknown.

contradictions: The Claude connector directory and ToolJunction list 26 tools, while APIs.io and MCP.so describe 18 tools under a different naming scheme. The sources do not establish whether the 18-name set is a renamed/revised inventory or a different capture; neither catalogue set is an official Kakao tool reference.

The supplied endpoint evidence reports a successful HTTP 200 JSON-RPC reachability test, while the separately supplied POST capture to the endpoint returned HTTP 400 “Invalid Content-Type header.” The request headers/method details for the successful test were not supplied, so the discrepancy cannot be resolved.

The authorization server metadata advertises identity and profile-related scopes including memberKey, memberName, memberNickname, ipinGender, ipinBirthDate, and realNameYn, while the public connector summaries emphasize music discovery and listening history and do not explain these scopes.
observations_for_research: The OAuth scopes disclose identity and profile fields beyond the music-focused capability summary; the relationship between those scopes and individual tools is undocumented.
Catalogues preserve two distinct tool-name/count inventories for the same global endpoint, complicating identification of the endpoint's current exposed tool set.
notes: Checked links.json, links_check.txt, all captured pages, script-rendered catalogue text, and code/GITHUB_COMMITS.txt. The endpoint POST probe's 400 response is preserved alongside the separately supplied HTTP 200 reachability result.
